title: 夠
teacherNotes: Production D lesson-local complete package. Latest origin/main at handoff is complete through L226. L227-L230 are provisional dependencies; Release owns ordered production JSON insertion, planner export, ledger update, final verify, merge, and deploy.

generationConstraints.allowedBoundary: latest origin/main production JSON through L226 plus provisional learned chars 舊, 半, 只, 剩 and current target 夠
imageRules: Generate square image / 1:1 composition for each sentence.
Use L058 lesson images only as illustration style references; do not copy any L058 person, clothing, face, hair, or body shape.
Use protagonist family identity anchors from L154/L162/L163 for protagonist mother, father, older brother, and protagonist little girl.
Every human prompt must explicitly name the role identity.
No written text, numbers, signs, labels, zhuyin, watermarks, logos, brands, vehicle plates, bottle marks, book text, or readable marks.
Each image must clearly match its approved image notes and remain phone-readable in a square crop.
audioRules: Use repo OpenAI audio flow only.
Generate charAudio for 夠 as public/assets/lessons/L231/audio/char-u5920.m4a from the single character.
Generate G02 prefix/suffix and G05 wrong-option audio as standalone whole-text files from exact text.

approvedSentences.imageNotes: 家裡餐桌場景，主角媽媽看著桌上剩下的一些飯菜，主角小女孩、主角爸爸、主角哥哥都在桌邊，飯菜看起來還夠全家人分著吃。畫面重點是「剩下的飯菜仍然夠大家吃」，不要做成很少或很可憐。不可有文字、數字或標籤。
主角小女孩和主角哥哥在戶外玩後看著一個透明水壺，裡面只剩很少一點水，兩人都很渴，明顯不夠分著喝。水壺不能有文字、數字、刻度、品牌或標籤。
主角媽媽和主角小女孩在家裡，媽媽從盒子裡只拿出一半的餅乾放到桌上，另一半餅乾還留在盒子裡，小女孩看著桌上的份量像是在問夠不夠。餅乾和盒子不可有文字、數字、品牌或標籤。
主角爸爸在一台老舊的小電動車或電動玩具車旁邊檢查，車燈很暗，主角小女孩在旁邊看著。畫面要呈現「舊車電力不足」，但不能出現電量數字、儀表文字、車牌、標籤或任何可讀文字。
主角小女孩坐在家裡或教室安靜看一本新書，書翻到中間位置，左右頁厚度看起來約各一半。可有書籤夾在中間，但書頁與封面不可有可讀文字、數字、品牌或標籤。

G01.reason: 「夠不夠」是本課核心問法，目標字清楚且出現兩次。
